observation: Wwox loss raises GSK-3beta activation; lithium abolishes PTZ seizures
relation_hypothesised: GSK-3beta drives Fyn/Src nuclear import and NRF2-Tyr568 phosphorylation, export and degradation, so NRF2 is low in WWOX deficiency
possible_action: Restore NRF2 (KEAP1 reduction/activation) or inhibit GSK-3beta
context: Wwox-/- mouse cortex, hippocampus, cerebellum; Src/Fyn data from non-neural cells
benefit_to_verify: NRF2 tone low and rescued by GSK-3beta inhibition; functional seizure/myelin benefit
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured in WWOX (GSK-3beta, lithium); link=transferred from other systems; NRF2 deficit=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Same node explains seizures and predicts suppressed NRF2; Src-deficient cells accumulate nuclear NRF2
unfavourable_or_alternative: Compensatory activation from neuroinflammation/mitochondrial ROS; axis assembled from separate literatures; cardiac/fibroblast context
discriminating_experiment: Measure nuclear NRF2, NQO1/HO-1/GCLC, GSH/GSSG in Wwox-/- tissue; lithium effect on NRF2 in Wwox-/- neurons
reasoning_pattern: A node validated causally in the disease is joined by literature from other cell types to a downstream pathway, and the pathway's sign is predicted without measurement

relation_hypothesised: Lost cell types are redox-vulnerable, so low NRF2/glutathione capacity explains their loss
possible_action: Raise NRF2/glutathione capacity (NAC or NRF2 activation)
context: Gclm-KO, TBI, schizophrenia review; Wwox-null for cell loss
benefit_to_verify: PV counts, myelination preserved in Wwox-deficient system
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured separately in each system; bridge=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Cell-type match; NAC rescue in other models
unfavourable_or_alternative: Vulnerability to glutathione deficit does not show NRF2 is low in WWOX; cell loss may arise from Wnt/GSK-3beta or inflammation
discriminating_experiment: Sorted PV+ and OPC-lineage NRF2/GSH measurement in Wwox-/-; NAC arm vs NRF2 activation
reasoning_pattern: A phenotype shared with a different redox-defect model is read as evidence of the same upstream deficit

unfavourable_or_alternative: Differentiation vs oxidative-protection effects entangled; remyelination models differ from developmental failure
discriminating_experiment: Stage-resolved OPC experiments in Wwox-/- with Nrf2 manipulation
reasoning_pattern: A required factor in repair models is assumed to be limiting in a developmental failure of the same cell step
